com.eloview.homesdk.infoManager

Class Info

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.eloview.homesdk.consts.Consts
      • com.eloview.homesdk.accountManager.AccountManager
        • com.eloview.homesdk.infoManager.Info
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Cloneable

    public class Info
extends AccountManager
    Info class provides device related information. It provides the below operations:
    • A method to get the device information getDeviceInfo
      • If the device is in Android home mode this method gives information such as the device MODEL, SERIAL, PRODUCT, DEVICE, MANUFACTURER, BOARD, BRAND, ID, and DISPLAY information in json format
      • If the device is in EloView mode, registered to an EloView account and Online, we can also get information such as parent_account", "state_province", "site_name", "device_name", "address_line_1", "postal_code", "country", "city", "group_name"
    • A method to register a broadcast receiver that receives any change in device info from EloView registerDeviceInfoReceiver
    • A method to unregister the broadcast receiver that receives any change in device info from EloView unregisterDeviceInfoReceiver
    • A method to get the SDK version number using getSDKVersion
    • A method to Check whether the SDK is supported or not on the current device using isSDKSupported

      • getDeviceInfo

        public void getDeviceInfo(android.content.Context context,
                          java.lang.String accessToken,
                          android.os.Handler handler)
        This method provides the device related information such as the device MODEL, SERIAL, PRODUCT, DEVICE, MANUFACTURER, BOARD, BRAND, ID, and DISPLAY information in json format If the device is registered on Eloview and was online at least once, then this method also provides details such as "parent_account", "state_province", "site_name", "device_name", "address_line_1", "postal_code", "country", "city", "group_name".
        Parameters:
        context - Context
        accessToken - An authentication token received from the Elo servers.
        handler - A handler to receive one or more of the following callback messages:

        AccountManager.TOKEN_VERIFY_FAIL
        DEVICE_INFO_CODE
        Consts.GENERIC_ERROR


      • registerDeviceInfoReceiver

        public int registerDeviceInfoReceiver(android.content.Context ctx,
                                      android.content.BroadcastReceiver deviceInfoReceiver)
        This method is used to notify any change in device info from EloView. This method works only in EloView mode and will fail to register receiver and return false in Android home mode.
        Parameters:
        ctx - it must be Activity or Application context
        deviceInfoReceiver - it must be BroadcastReceiver and it will return device info parameters in key/val pair format
        Returns:
        REGISTERED_SUCCESSFULLY_CODE if receiver successfully registered else REGISTERED_EXCEPTION_CODE

      • unregisterDeviceInfoReceiver

        public int unregisterDeviceInfoReceiver(android.content.Context ctx,
                                        android.content.BroadcastReceiver deviceInfoReceiver)
        This method is used to unregister the EloView device info change listener. This method works only in EloView mode and will fail to unregister receiver and return UNREGISTERED_EXCEPTION_CODE in Android home mode.
        Parameters:
        ctx - it must be Activity or Application context
        deviceInfoReceiver - it must be BroadcastReceiver that is registered
        Returns:
        UNREGISTERED_SUCCESSFULLY_CODE -if receiver successfully unregistered -if device is not connected to eloview mode UNREGISTERED_EXCEPTION_CODE - if context or deviceInfoReceiver is null
